title: langgraph-checkpoint-postgres==3.1.3
summary: Changes since checkpointpostgres==3.1.2 release(checkpoint-postgres): 3.1.3 ( #9287 ) fix(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): treat an empty checkpoint_id as the latest in delta history ( #9262 ) perf(checkpoint-postgres): start the delta walk at the target ( #9248 ) fix(checkpoint,checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): validate namespace labels before store dispatch ( #9217 ) fix: order delta channel replay by
body:
Changes since checkpointpostgres==3.1.2

- release(checkpoint-postgres): 3.1.3 ( #9287 )

- fix(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): treat an empty checkpoint_id as the latest in delta history ( #9262 )

- perf(checkpoint-postgres): start the delta walk at the target ( #9248 )

- fix(checkpoint,checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): validate namespace labels before store dispatch ( #9217 )

- fix: order delta channel replay by task path ( #8544 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint-postgres with 6 updates ( #9147 )

- chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /libs/checkpoint-postgres ( #9132 )

- fix(checkpoint-postgres): derive the delta walk cursor once the target loads ( #8556 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint-postgres with 3 updates ( #8773 )

- fix(checkpoint): widen Store put value type to Mapping[str, Any] ( #8617 )
summaryZh: LangGraph发布了PostgreSQL状态存储扩展包3.1.3版本。本次更新修复了空检查点标识符处理和任务路径回放顺序等问题，并优化了增量历史遍历的游标起始性能。该更新提升了持久化智能体工作流在生产数据库中的运行稳定性。

aiReview.reasonZh: LangGraph PostgreSQL状态检查点库的例行补丁更新，优化了增量遍历性能与历史回放逻辑。
